lead: Gunmen killed the bursar of the National Open University on his way back from Gusau, and Zamfara's deputy police commissioner for operations died in hospital. The consumer protection commission opened an inquiry into how Uber handled customers when it left Nigeria. The NDLEA found more than two tonnes of cannabis hidden in a fuel tanker, D'Tigress went out of the Women's World Cup, and the SDP candidate promised petrol at N200 a litre.

items.h: NOUN bursar shot dead in Zamfara
items.s: Nasiru Gusau Marafa, bursar of the National Open University of Nigeria, was shot dead while returning from Gusau, the university's registrar announced on Sunday.

items.h: FCCPC investigates Uber's exit and unfinished customer services
items.s: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission chief Tunji Bello said the agency is examining how Uber dealt with services it had not fulfilled for customers when it left Nigeria.

items.h: NDLEA finds 2,145kg of cannabis in fuel tanker and seizes 2m opioid pills
items.s: The NDLEA intercepted a 20,000-litre fuel tanker with a hidden compartment holding 2,145kg of cannabis and recovered more than two million opioid pills in coordinated operations.

items.h: Military says 36 kidnap victims rescued and terrorist kingpin killed
items.s: Defence Headquarters spokesman Maj.-Gen. Michael Onoja said troops freed 36 abducted people and killed several terrorists, including a kingpin, in recent operations.

items.h: Zamfara's deputy police commissioner for operations dies
items.s: Zamfara police said their deputy commissioner for operations, DCP Asbagu Aliyu Muhammad, died early on Sunday at the specialist hospital in Gusau.

items.h: Three siblings found dead near stream in Akure
items.s: Eleven-year-old twins Joshua and Jacob Jonah and their sibling were found dead near a stream on a farm close to Owena Army Barracks, Akure.

items.h: D'Tigress eliminated from Women's World Cup
items.s: Nigeria's women's basketball team went out of the FIBA World Cup in Berlin after France beat South Korea 95-69, ending their hopes of reaching the knockout stage. The players apologised to Nigerians.

items.h: SDP candidate Adebayo promises N200 petrol if elected
items.s: Adewole Adebayo, the Social Democratic Party's presidential candidate, said he would cut the price of petrol, cooking gas and aviation fuel to N200 a litre if he wins in 2027.

items.h: Government says subsidy return would threaten stability as reforms steady prices
items.s: Information Minister Mohammed Idris called demands to restore the petrol subsidy unpatriotic and a risk to public finances. The government said the reforms have brought a reasonable degree of price stability and growth.

items.h: NMDPRA explains continued swings in petrol prices
items.s: The downstream regulator said petrol prices remain volatile because of how crude is sourced, reliance on a single domestic refinery, and logistics and transport costs.

items.h: JAMB sets 320 UTME score and 80% SSCE mark for underage admission
items.s: JAMB said candidates under the age limit need at least 320 in the UTME and 80 per cent in their school certificate results to be considered for university admission.

items.h: Exits and imposition claims hit Bauchi APC
items.s: Senior APC figures in Bauchi, including former governorship contenders and legislative aspirants, have resigned from the party, deepening its crisis before 2027.

items.h: APC chairman receives Kano defectors, including NDC's only senator there
items.s: APC national chairman Nentawe Yilwatda welcomed politicians who left opposition parties in Kano, among them former senator Rufa'i Hanga, who resigned from the NDC.

items.h: Akpabio asks Northern youths to back Tinubu's reforms
items.s: Senate President Godswill Akpabio urged a delegation of the Northern Ethnic Groups Assembly in Abuja to support President Tinubu's re-election and the continuity of his economic policies.

items.h: Wike says Rivers will back Tinubu in 2027
items.s: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike said President Tinubu is now 'our brother' and that the people of Rivers will support his re-election.

items.h: Datti Baba-Ahmed dismisses Obi and Atiku as alternatives to Tinubu
items.s: Yusuf Datti Baba-Ahmed, Peter Obi's 2023 running mate, said none of the leading challengers, including Obi, could improve Nigeria.

items.h: EFCC may not reopen 2006 case against Atiku, sources say
items.s: Leadership reported that the EFCC is unlikely to act on a former lawmaker's request to reopen a 2006 corruption case against Atiku Abubakar.

items.h: Rivers Assembly probes state funds to Pamo University
items.s: The Rivers State House of Assembly opened an inquiry into money the state has released to Pamo University of Medical Sciences since 2017, after stepping down a N6 billion subvention in the 2026 budget.

items.h: Ex-IGP Adamu promises to end bad governance in Nasarawa
items.s: Former Inspector-General Mohammed Adamu, who won the SDP's Nasarawa governorship ticket in a fresh primary, pledged to end years of poor governance.

items.h: Taraba sets up task force on illegal mining
items.s: Governor Agbu Kefas formed an eight-member task force to enforce the state's ban on illegal mining and protect forests.

items.h: Enugu police say 211 kidnap victims rescued in 17 months
items.s: Enugu police said they held 6,240 suspects, recovered 156 firearms and freed 211 kidnapped people over 17 months of operations.

items.h: Troops dislodge bandits and seize arms in Sokoto
items.s: Soldiers of Operation Fansan Yamma drove terrorist elements out of parts of Tangaza Local Government Area and recovered a cache of weapons.

items.h: Troops destroy terrorists' health facility in Katsina forest
items.s: The army said soldiers attacked terrorists in the Yantumaki forest area and destroyed a facility they used for treatment.

items.h: Troops rescue kidnap victim in Benue and arrest suspect
items.s: Operation Whirl Stroke rescued an abducted person and arrested a suspected kidnapper in operations in Benue and Nasarawa on Sunday.

items.h: Police arrest seven over Bauchi clash that killed two
items.s: Bauchi police arrested seven suspects for conspiracy, inciting disturbance and homicide after violence in Dass on 4 September.

items.h: HURIWA asks police to prosecute politicians over inciting remarks
items.s: The Human Rights Writers Association urged the police to go beyond warnings and prosecute Senator Francis Fadahunsi, Kuje council chairman Danjuma Shekwolo and Borno commissioner Sainna Buba.

items.h: Tompolo-backed group takes Tinubu campaign to Katsina
items.s: A movement backed by Government Ekpemupolo deployed campaign vehicles across Katsina, where Tinubu narrowly lost in 2023. Governor Dikko Radda called the state an APC stronghold.

items.h: Yobe traditional rulers endorse Tinubu and APC candidate Wali
items.s: APC governorship candidate Baba Malam Wali said traditional rulers across Yobe have backed him and President Tinubu for 2027.

items.h: Factions and court cases weaken Zamfara ADC
items.s: A leadership dispute in the African Democratic Congress in Zamfara has grown into rival factions, defections and lawsuits.

items.h: Bauchi governor Bala Mohammed eyes Senate seat in 2027
items.s: Governor Bala Mohammed is seeking a Senate seat in 2027, an attempt his predecessors failed to achieve, BusinessDay reported.

items.h: Uba Sani credits Gani Fawehinmi with opening political space
items.s: Kaduna Governor Uba Sani said the late lawyer Gani Fawehinmi's greatest contribution was his fight to keep Nigeria's political space open to opposition.

items.h: Sunbeth redeems N25.1bn commercial paper
items.s: Agro-commodities trader Sunbeth Global Concepts repaid its N25.1 billion Series 1 commercial paper, issued under a N200 billion programme, on schedule.

items.h: Tantita says higher growth needs more oil output
items.s: Pipeline security contractor Tantita said faster GDP growth in 2026 depends on raising oil production and keeping pipelines protected.

items.h: NFF confident Super Falcons will qualify for 2028 Olympics
items.s: The Nigeria Football Federation said it expects the Super Falcons to qualify for a second straight Olympic women's football tournament.

items.h: Infantino to seek fourth term as FIFA president
items.s: FIFA said Gianni Infantino, its president since 2016, will run again in the March 2027 election despite criticism of a dropped plan to sell stakes in its competitions.

items.h: Regina Daniels still single, sister says after visit to Ned Nwoko's home
items.s: Actress Regina Daniels' sister said she has not reconciled with Senator Ned Nwoko, after a video showed her at his house with their children.
